description: Fires when the right edge column (column 6) holds exactly 3 stones, so the next stone there lands in the 4th row, and the board is well filled elsewhere: at least three of columns 0-5 have 4+ stones (full central columns 3-4 matter most). It is weak or negative in the opening and is often damped right after a stone was just dropped into column 6.
effect: Small: changes column 6's probability by up to about 10 points; the sign depends on the position (zeroing raised col 6 by 10 points in one position and lowered it by 6 in another).
notes: Col6 height==3 is a clean gate (every top example; adding a 4th stone kills it). The modulator is fuzzy board fullness, strongest for central columns; last-move-in-col-6 and side-to-move parity matter inside single games but did not improve the dev metric. Best dev F1 0.657 (P .53, R .86, AUROC .92), sim share 0.83. Synthesis best 7.32 < dev max 7.80.
